model_output.rationale: Digital Asset is not an AI company: Canton is privacy-preserving DLT infrastructure with no AI-driven moat, tripping ID8's AI hard-auto-pass. A genuine new-money Tier 1 lead (a16z) and elite founder exits (Creditex, DRW) don't override that mandate miss.
model_output.hard_auto_pass_reason: No AI component -- AI Score subcategories (Ownership of models, Data flywheel) both score 1; Canton Network is privacy-preserving DLT infrastructure, not an AI/ML product.
